Name: MAP_PARTS_PARAM_ST
Description: Determines the parameters that relate to map parts.

Fields.Name: Camera Dither: Minimum Fade Distance
Fields.Description: The minimum fade distance for camera dithering for a map part. In metres. Setting both this and the maximum fade distance to 0.0 disables camera dither fading.

Fields.Name: Camera Dither: Maximum Fade Distance
Fields.Description: The maximum fade distance for camera dithering for a map part. In metres. Setting both this and the minimum fade distance to 0.0 disables camera dither fading.
